source: One separate Python read-only command using os.getloadavg, os.sysconf and own resource limits; recorded by root from the returned agent report
purpose: Bounded observation during slower complete fresh compilation; no performance experiment or validation intervention
limitations: System values exposed to the observer command, not compiler-specific measurements
Does not establish compiler RSS, effective CPU entitlement, container memory limits, swapping or competing workloads
Does not establish CPU saturation or memory pressure experienced by Lean
Does not establish old-descendant liveness or quiescence
No process signaling, source/cache/profile change, compiler launch or network action by the observer
